Name: Today's MVP Tool
Author: EliteWise
Description:
Tracks the player's main tool uses during the day and names the most-used one [b]MVP Tool of the Day[/b].
Supported tools:
[list]
[*]Pickaxe[/*]
[*]Axe[/*]
[*]Hoe[/*]
[*]Watering Can[/*]
[*]Fishing Rod[/*]
[*]Scythe[/*]
[/list]The result appears after the nightly earnings screen. If no supported tool was used, no extra screen is shown. Counters reset at the start of every day.
